title: Work Runner
purpose: Shows what the Claude work runner is doing: mode, the job running now, the last runs, the pace gate and the worker lock.
description: Read-only status page. The runner claims jobs from the Work add-on, runs them with the Claude CLI and reports on the task. Start, stop and the STOP switch are on the Work page.
navigation: Shows the mode (dry or live) and why it is paused, if it is
Shows the job running now (title only) and how long it has run
Lists the last 20 runs with result and duration
Links to the Work page, where the STOP switch is
access: Home Assistant authenticated ingress only; read-only, no secrets shown
